title: RCK: Resonant Cognitive Kernel
description: A symbolic, non-generative reasoning system: facts live as discrete (subject, relation, object) triples in a sharded HRR/VSA hyperdimensional vector memory; reasoning is an explicit, inspectable pipeline with derivation-graph provenance, calibrated confidence, gated fact induction, belief revision, negative facts, and federated merge. 100,000 real-world facts on a single CPU thread with sub-millisecond queries. Every empirical claim in the accompanying paper is reproducible from a script in scripts/ and a committed artifact in data/.
